name: pending_heal
source: per-frame replays 2026-11-14: run 20261112-103604-0c64 frames 61400-61414 (243/0, a heart refill: 7 then one less every 2 frames while hp rises 9 to 16, Link walking right the whole time) and run 20261114-005942-a8f3 frames 88805-89041 (83/0, the healing scene after its dialogue: 3 or 4 while hp rises 20 to 24, then 4 and 0 on alternate frames at full health until 89041; inputs moved Link in none of those frames, and he walked again about 60 frames later); a8f3 descends from 0c64, so one lineage; hypothesis from general knowledge (the health-add buffer)
note: health still to add to hp, one unit every 2 frames; the play mode is not ready while it is nonzero, and the 2 settled frames the readiness needs skip its alternating 4/0 at full health; it does not hold Link by itself (he walks during a heart refill); in the 83/0 scene the hold is a flickering motion_blocked (review KOHO-61), and the 4/0 there is the scene re-arming the add

name: pending_damage
source: per-frame replays 2026-11-14 of three hits in two independent run lineages: run 20261114-000016-cc52 frames 90261-90268 (66/0, an enemy hit), run 20261113-235935-9618 frames 91260-91267 (189/10, after a hole fall, no knockback), both forks of 20261113-090835-21b0, and run 20261024-184627-b97e frames 21068-21075 (its first hit, another lineage, the committed run; re-measured independently in the KOHO-57 review: 24/0 at 21067, 24/4 with knockback 16 at 21068, then 23/3, 22/2, 21/1 and 20/0 at 21075): on the hit frame it holds the hit's whole damage (4 in all three) while hp (0xDB5A) is unchanged, then hp and this byte each lose one every 2 frames until it reads 0; hypothesis from general knowledge (the health-subtract buffer)
note: damage still to drain from hp; GameState#health (hp minus this) is the health Link is left with, which the damage checks compare; 0xDB93 stayed 0 in the same frames (the healing counterpart is not measured)

name: room_objects

note: one object id per 16 px cell of the current room (10 per row, rows 16 bytes apart); kinds per id in data/entities.json (entries with an object key)

name: dialogue_cooldown

note: 24 at the frame a dialogue closes, then minus one per frame; A cannot open a new dialogue before it reaches 0, so talk_to presses A again every 12 frames; meaning outside dialogues not measured; not read by the engine

name: shield_box
